title: Domino tilings of black-and-white Temperleyan cylinders
summary: We consider the dimer model in cylindrical domains $Ω_δ$ on square grids of mesh size $δ$ with two Temperleyan boundary components of different colors. Assuming that the $Ω_δ$ approximate a cylindrical domain $Ω$ as $δ\to 0$, we prove the convergence of height fluctuations to the Gaussian Free Field in $Ω$ plus an independent discrete Gaussian multiple of the harmonic measure of one of the boundary components.
